title: "I don't see it": MAIN has it checked where the user looks, never says refresh
persona: A phone user who asked for a small page and then cannot see what they asked for. Short messages. They do not explain why.
goals: Have main get a tiny HTML page built in a folder named export-demo: index.html with a heading and an 'Export' button.
When main says it is done, tell main you don't see the Export button (say only that, nothing about why).
Get a concrete answer: was the button there, where exactly, or what was wrong and fixed.
script: Ask for the page in your own short words.
Wait for main to report it built.
Say you don't see the Export button.
Read what main finds out, then finish.

checks.name: main never says refresh / reopen / reload / clear the cache
main had it checked (a session read or re-sent)
